plugin.openai.name: OpenAI
plugin.openai.description: GPT models through the OpenAI API, with answers checked against a schema.
plugin.openai.model.help: The model id, for example gpt-4.1 or gpt-4.1-mini.
plugin.openai.base_url.help: Change only to go through a proxy that serves the same API.
plugin.openai_compatible.name: OpenAI-compatible API
plugin.openai_compatible.description: Any service with the OpenAI chat API: OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM, Groq and others.
plugin.openai_compatible.base_url.help: The address that ends before /chat/completions, for example http://localhost:1234/v1.
plugin.openai_compatible.model.help: The model id as the service names it.
plugin.openai_compatible.structured.help: JSON mode works almost everywhere; a JSON schema is stricter, when the service supports it.
